listAsq.title: Who buys broken laptops in Atlanta?
listAsq.content: We specialize in buying all kinds of laptops across the Greater Atlanta area — including non-working, damaged, or water-exposed devices. Whether your screen is cracked, the battery doesn’t hold charge, or the laptop doesn’t power on at all, we’ll evaluate it for parts and make you a fair cash offer the same day.

listAsq.title: Do I need to delete my personal data before selling?
listAsq.content: Not necessarily. Our technicians perform a full drive format and professional data removal before completing every purchase. However, if you prefer, you can back up your files or sign out of your accounts first — just to keep your own peace of mind.

listAsq.title: What do I need to sell my laptop?
listAsq.content: You’ll just need your laptop and a valid ID. Having the charger and original box may increase the offer slightly. We buy most major brands including Apple, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Asus, Acer, and MSI.

listAsq.title: How does the laptop selling process work?
listAsq.content: Simply send us a few photos of your laptop to get an instant quote. If you accept the offer, one of our technicians will come directly to your location — home, office, or public place — and complete the purchase the same day. You’ll get paid immediately by cash, Zelle, or bank transfer.
